name: fakturownia-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for Fakturownia / InvoiceOcean invoicing: invoices, clients, products, payments.

domain.title: Account domain
domain.description: Your account subdomain: mycompany, mycompany.fakturownia.pl or mycompany.invoiceocean.com

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: API authorization code from your account settings (Integration section); sent only in the Authorization header

download_dir.title: PDF download directory
download_dir.description: Invoice PDFs are saved only inside this directory

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Search invoices by period, client, number, kind; income=false lists expenses

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Full invoice record with line items

tools.name: send_invoice_by_email
tools.description: E-mail the invoice PDF to the buyer or given recipients (approval required)

tools.name: download_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Save the invoice PDF into the configured download directory

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Banking payments, optionally with the invoices they settle

tools.name: create_payment
tools.description: Record incoming money against invoices (approval required)

tools.name: delete_payment
tools.description: Remove a mistaken payment record (approval required)

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: Search contractors by name, tax id, e-mail

prompts.name: monthly_summary
prompts.description: Revenue, costs, unpaid invoices and payments for one month
prompts.text: Prepare a financial summary of my Fakturownia account for month ${arguments.month} (empty = current month): total revenue and costs from list_invoices (income=false for costs), incoming money from list_payments(include_invoices=true), unpaid or partially paid sales invoices, and payments not linked to any invoice. Present a short table plus 2-3 sentences of commentary; amounts are strings in the account currency.

prompts.name: chase_unpaid
prompts.description: Find overdue invoices and draft payment reminders (nothing is sent without approval)
prompts.text: Find my overdue invoices: list_invoices(period='all'), keep unpaid sales invoices with payment_to before today, confirm buyer e-mails via get_invoice, then show a table (number, buyer, e-mail, gross amount, days overdue) and draft a short polite reminder in Polish for each. Do NOT send anything until I explicitly pick invoices; send_invoice_by_email will still ask for approval.
